# Generated Cmake Pico project file

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

# Initialise pico_sdk from installed location
# (note this can come from environment, CMake cache etc)

# == DO NOT EDIT THE FOLLOWING LINES for the Raspberry Pi Pico VS Code Extension to work ==
if(WIN32)
    set(USERHOME $ENV{USERPROFILE})
else()
    set(USERHOME $ENV{HOME})
endif()
set(sdkVersion 2.2.0)
set(toolchainVersion RISCV_ZCB_RPI_2_2_0_3)
set(picotoolVersion 2.2.0-a4)
set(picoVscode ${USERHOME}/.pico-sdk/cmake/pico-vscode.cmake)
if (EXISTS ${picoVscode})
    include(${picoVscode})
endif()
# ====================================================================================
set(PICO_BOARD pico2 CACHE STRING "Board type")

# Pull in Raspberry Pi Pico SDK (must be before project)
include(pico_sdk_import.cmake)

project(ws2812_controller_code C CXX ASM)

# Initialise the Raspberry Pi Pico SDK
pico_sdk_init()

# Add executable. Default name is the project name, version 0.1

add_executable(ws2812_controller_code 
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/ws2812_controller_code.c
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/ws2812_controller_functions.c
)

pico_set_program_name(ws2812_controller_code "ws2812_controller_code")
pico_set_program_version(ws2812_controller_code "0.1")

# Generate PIO header
pico_generate_pio_header(ws2812_controller_code ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/LED_output.pio)

# Modify the below lines to enable/disable output over UART/USB
pico_enable_stdio_uart(ws2812_controller_code 0)
pico_enable_stdio_usb(ws2812_controller_code 1)


# Add the standard include files to the build
target_include_directories(ws2812_controller_code PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/include
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src # need to include so the header file generated by .pio is able to be read
)

# Add any user requested libraries
target_link_libraries(ws2812_controller_code
        pico_stdlib
        hardware_dma
        hardware_pio
        )

pico_add_extra_outputs(ws2812_controller_code)
